subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in Spanish on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (Spanish↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: What does 'el alojamiento' mean?
questions.explain: 'El alojamiento' means 'accommodation' (where you stay); 'alojarse' = 'to stay/lodge'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to book a double room'?
options: Me gustaría reservar una habitación doble
Me gustaría reservar una habitación individual
Me gusta reservar una habitación doble
Me gustaría recordar una habitación doble
questions.explain: 'Reservar' = 'to book' and 'doble' = 'double'; 'recordar' (to remember) is a near-miss distractor.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'The plane is delayed'?
questions.explain: 'Llevar retraso' means 'to be delayed', so 'El avión lleva retraso' = 'The plane is delayed'.

questions.q: What does 'hacer turismo' mean?
questions.explain: 'Hacer turismo' means 'to go sightseeing / do tourism'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I spent two weeks on the coast'?
options: Pasé dos semanas en la costa
Paso dos semanas en la costa
Pasaré dos semanas en la costa
Pasé dos semanas en la montaña
questions.explain: 'Pasé' is the preterite 'I spent' and 'la costa' = 'the coast', so the first option is correct.

questions.q: What does 'el billete de ida y vuelta' mean?
questions.explain: 'Ida y vuelta' means 'there and back', so 'el billete de ida y vuelta' = 'a return ticket'.

questions.q: What does 'la pantalla' mean?
questions.explain: 'La pantalla' means 'the screen' (of a phone, TV or computer).

questions.q: How do you say 'I spend too much time on my mobile'?
options: Paso demasiado tiempo en el móvil
Paso poco tiempo en el móvil
Gasto demasiado dinero en el móvil
Paso demasiado tiempo en el ordenador
questions.explain: 'Pasar tiempo' = 'to spend time' (use 'gastar' only for money); 'demasiado' = 'too much'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Social media can be dangerous'?
options: Las redes sociales pueden ser peligrosas
Las redes sociales pueden ser seguras
Las redes sociales son siempre divertidas
Los medios sociales puede ser peligroso
questions.explain: 'Las redes sociales' is feminine plural, so 'peligrosas' agrees; 'pueden ser peligrosas' = 'can be dangerous'.

questions.q: What does 'el correo electrónico' mean?
questions.explain: 'El correo electrónico' literally 'electronic mail' means 'email'.

questions.q: What does 'navegar por internet' mean?
questions.explain: 'Navegar por internet' means 'to surf/browse the internet'.

questions.q: What does 'el medio ambiente' mean?
questions.explain: 'El medio ambiente' is the fixed term for 'the environment' (nature).

questions.q: How do you say 'We must recycle more'?
questions.explain: 'Tenemos que' = 'we must/have to' and 'reciclar más' = 'recycle more'.

questions.q: What does 'el calentamiento global' mean?
questions.explain: 'El calentamiento global' means 'global warming'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'There is a lot of pollution in the city'?
options: Hay mucha contaminación en la ciudad
Hay mucha contaminación en el campo
Hay poca contaminación en la ciudad
Había mucha contaminación en la ciudad
questions.explain: 'Hay' = 'there is', 'la contaminación' = 'pollution', 'la ciudad' = 'the city'.

questions.q: What does 'ahorrar energía' mean?
questions.explain: 'Ahorrar' means 'to save', so 'ahorrar energía' = 'to save energy'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I live in a quiet neighbourhood'?
questions.explain: 'El barrio' is masculine, so 'tranquilo' agrees; 'vivo' is the correct first-person form.

questions.q: How would you write 'limpio' to describe two beaches ('playas')?
questions.explain: 'Playa' is feminine, so the plural adjective is feminine plural: 'limpias'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'If we recycled more, we would help the planet'?
options: Si recicláramos más, ayudaríamos al planeta
Si reciclamos más, ayudamos al planeta
Si reciclaremos más, ayudaríamos al planeta
Si reciclábamos más, ayudaremos al planeta
questions.explain: An unreal condition uses imperfect subjunctive + conditional: 'recicláramos... ayudaríamos'.

questions.q: Which means 'I will travel to Spain next year' (future)?
options: Viajaré a España el año que viene
Viajé a España el año pasado
questions.explain: 'Viajaré' is the future tense 'I will travel'; with 'el año que viene' (next year) the future is correct.
